bullets.text: He feels his game is coming together after a refreshing break.
bullets.quote: I'm definitely feeling a lot better. I'm feeling in a good place. I feel like everything is kind of clicking.

bullets.text: He used the mid-season break to refresh and recharge, and is easing back in his first week.
bullets.quote: I've been able to kind of take a step back and kind of refresh and get a lot of energy

bullets.text: First tournament back, so low expectations and expecting to build match rhythm as the week progresses.
bullets.quote: It's my first week back, right, so it's not too many expectations... I know I'm going to be building and getting better every single day.

bullets.text: Says his ball-striking felt off last week but has clicked into place since arriving in D.C.
bullets.quote: That really wasn't the case last week in Florida. I feel like I was playing terrible, and then I got here, and everything seemed to feel pretty good.

bullets.text: Feels good about his game and typically strikes the ball clean in D.C.
bullets.quote: most of the times I come here, I feel like I strike the ball very clean

bullets.text: Ramped up training recently after a lighter stretch, feels his fitness has been maintained.
bullets.quote: I wasn't doing a ton of training at least two weeks ago, and then last week I ramped it up.

bullets.text: Despite frustration over losing finals, believes a breakthrough win is coming soon.
bullets.quote: one will definitely go my way here soon.

bullets.text: He believes his level is trending up and he's positioned for a strong second half if he plays to his standard.
bullets.quote: if I play the level that I know I, I guess, or I think I should be playing for the rest of the year... I'm in a decent place to still have a strong finish

bullets.text: Fritz emphasizes his strong ability to stay present and move past mistakes on court.
bullets.quote: I don't really let things bother me, especially when I'm on the court. I try to stay very in the moment.

bullets.text: He feels the extended schedule has made the season notably longer and more taxing.
bullets.quote: it feels like I'm playing more matches. It feels like the season got longer to me... now that we're doing it, yeah, it feels, like, really long.

bullets.text: Fritz is frustrated by inconsistent ball quality, saying practice balls can differ greatly from tournament balls.
bullets.quote: what's the point of practicing if the ball that I'm practicing with is going to be completely different to the one here?

bullets.text: Dealt with physical issues after Wimbledon but says he resolved them during the break.
bullets.quote: I was trying to get my body right, healthy. Played a lot. So, yeah, came straight home, fixed a few kinks that I had.

bullets.text: Comes in fresh and rested after three weeks off, ready to compete.
bullets.quote: I haven't played in three weeks. Excited to get out there and play doubles.

bullets.text: Reads his own level as strong and highly consistent this season.
bullets.quote: I've been extremely consistent this year. Winning a lot of matches... giving myself a chance week in, week out.

bullets.text: Feels good and realistic about results, though admits some home-crowd nerves.
bullets.quote: you get a little nervous, but I mean, it's part of it, and it's a great experience.

bullets.text: Ball quality concerns don't affect him; conditions feel unchanged.
bullets.quote: To me it felt the same way it did last week. I don't know.

bullets.text: Shelton acknowledges an inconsistent season but believes his form typically returns on North American hard courts.
bullets.quote: no matter how I come off the European season, I usually am pretty good at finding my form here on the hard courts

bullets.text: He views the hard courts and hot conditions as a major advantage for him.
bullets.quote: I feel the most comfortable playing on this surface and in these conditions. It being hot outside, I think it's a huge advantage for me.

bullets.text: He got an early head start on fitness and heat acclimation after Wimbledon by training in Florida.
bullets.quote: get acclimated to the heat right away and start training immediately, it was big for me

bullets.text: He feels good and eager heading into the event after strong training.
bullets.quote: The last three weeks for me in terms of training has been great, and I'm really looking forward to getting started here.

bullets.text: He is frustrated by inconsistency and early-round 'trap round' exits this season.
bullets.quote: the inconsistency of my play is what I've been more frustrated about

bullets.text: Battled his body for the past year but has recovered and reduced his injury count.
bullets.quote: I had, like, four injuries, but now I have, like, two, so

bullets.text: Only recently regained feel for his tennis after two months of hard practice.
bullets.quote: I didn't feel my tennis until one month ago. I've been practicing a lot last two months.

bullets.text: Uncertain about match level, hasn't played a good match in over a year.
bullets.quote: I haven't played good match since, I would say, before French last year, so I don't know how I can play tomorrow

bullets.text: Feels calm now but expects different, heightened emotions once he steps on court.
bullets.quote: right now I'm still calm and relaxed, but I know if I step in the court playing a match, I know I'm going to start feel different feeling
